description: This PHP script manages user editing functionality within the TestLink project, including creating, updating, password resetting, and API key generation for users. It handles form input processing, database interactions, user validation, and rendering the user interface via Smarty templates.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: User entity class representing user data with methods for database interactions and property management.

classes.name: tlRole
classes.description: Role entity class, including static methods for retrieving roles from database.

classes.name: APIKey
classes.description: Class for managing API keys associated with users, including generating and adding new keys.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Wrapper or extension of Smarty template engine for rendering views.

classes.name: tl
classes.description: Constants class, e.g., tl::OK, tl::ERROR, used for status codes.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters for user actions.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new user, including password setting and database writing.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Performs user property updates and saves changes to the database.

methods.name: createNewPassword
methods.description: Generates and assigns a new password for a user, with email notification if configured.

methods.name: createNewAPIKey
methods.description: Generates and assigns a new API key for a user, with email notification.

methods.name: initializeUserProperties
methods.description: Populates a user object with data, sanitizing input fields.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Renders the user editing interface based on current action context.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares GUI state and data for user management views.

methods.name: initLabels
methods.description: Initializes label mappings for interface localization.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has rights to manage users.
